name: Namaste Sharade Devi
text:
नमस्ते शारदे देवि काश्मीरपुरवासिनि ।
त्वामहं प्रार्थये नित्यं विद्यादानं च देहि मे ॥
meaning: Salutations to Goddess Sharada, who dwells in Kashmir. I pray to you every day: please grant me the gift of knowledge.
purpose: A prayer to Sharada for knowledge.
note: The client list reads “Vidya Dhanam” (knowledge and wealth); the verse is usually recited “vidyādānam”, the gift of knowledge.
